note: The pre-D052 wave gait (T 1.6 s, 32 mm step) that the D050 residual walk policies and the D048 push/cliff experiments ran on (= sim/rl_common.LEGACY_GAIT). Kept as data so `check` can show why it was retired: its step lift alone is past the D052 loaded-speed budget, so WaveGait.budget() zeroes every command on it - it stands, it does not walk.
